tldr: 台積電市值衝上約65兆元，董事長魏哲家喊「要買請繼續」，ADR逼近新天價，帶動AI供應鏈全面走強。
漲價潮席捲晶片業，意法半導體與聯發科相繼對客戶發出MCU／IC調漲通知，DRAM缺貨更延燒到舊製程DDR產品。
台灣景氣展望大幅轉強，瑞銀將2026年GDP預測上修至9.9%，IMD世界競爭力排名躍居全球第4、寫歷年最佳。
財富管理動能升溫，臺企銀獲准開辦財管2.0、搶攻高資產客戶市場，財管業務已連3年雙位數成長。
國際市場因AI焦慮與中東情勢震盪：Alphabet因人才流失疑慮創逾一年最大跌幅，美伊和緩、伊朗獲准以美元售油壓低油價。

items.title_zh: 台積電市值衝65兆 魏哲家喊「要買請繼續」ADR飆近7%
items.title_en: TSMC market cap nears NT$65 trillion as Wei tells investors "keep buying"
items.summary_zh: 台積電市值一路攀升、逼近65兆元，董事長魏哲家公開對想進場的投資人喊話「要買請繼續」，罕見地釋放高度信心，激勵台積電美國ADR單日飆漲近7%、新天價呼之欲出。樂觀氛圍擴散到整條AI硬體供應鏈，在外資季底作帳行情前回補大型權值股之際，強化市場對先進製程與先進封裝的需求預期，也成為支撐大盤續攻的核心動能。
items.summary_en: Taiwan Semiconductor's valuation climbed toward NT$65 trillion as chairman C.C. Wei publicly urged investors who want to buy to "keep buying," a rare show of confidence that sent TSMC's U.S.-listed ADRs up nearly 7% and within reach of fresh record highs. The bullish tone radiated across the AI hardware chain, reinforcing demand expectations for advanced nodes and packaging just as foreign institutions rotate back into large-cap tech ahead of the quarter-end window-dressing period.

items.title_zh: 法人搶卡位季底作帳行情 提早買進南亞、華邦電等18檔集團強勢股
items.title_en: Institutions pre-position for quarter-end window dressing, piling into 18 group heavyweights
items.summary_zh: 距季底作帳行情僅剩數日，三大法人提早布局卡位，買盤集中在南亞科、華邦電等約18檔集團強勢股。法人指出，多項市場利空陸續退場，記憶體與AI伺服器需求兩大題材則持續延燒，內外資搶買名單浮現。在最後衝刺階段，作帳行情題材與基本面同步發酵，使集團權值股成為盤面資金主戰場，後續仍須觀察量能能否延續。
items.summary_en: With only days left before the quarter-end "window-dressing" rally, the three major institutional investors have moved early to lock in positions, concentrating buying in roughly 18 strong group-affiliated stocks including Nanya Technology and Winbond. Brokerages argue several headline risks have receded while two recurring themes—memory and AI server demand—continue to burn, leaving a watch-list of names that both foreign and domestic funds are accumulating ahead of the final stretch.

items.title_zh: 以紙業起家的百年永豐餘 端出AI時代轉型大計
items.title_en: Century-old Yuen Foong Yu reinvents itself for the AI era
items.summary_zh: 逾百歲的老牌紙業集團永豐餘正推動大規模轉型，在AI重塑各行各業之際，運用旗下工業資產與能源、材料事業，尋求跳脫傳統造紙本業的新成長動能。此案凸顯台灣傳產龍頭如何環繞AI需求、資料中心用電與新材料商機重新定位，積極打造第二成長曲線，而非僅守住逐漸萎縮的核心市場，也為傳產股的價值重估提供想像空間。
items.summary_en: Yuen Foong Yu, the more than 100-year-old paper conglomerate, is pushing an ambitious transformation to stay relevant as AI reshapes industry, leveraging its industrial assets and energy/materials businesses to pivot beyond its legacy paper roots. The case highlights how Taiwan's traditional manufacturers are repositioning around AI-driven demand, data-center power needs and new materials, seeking second growth curves rather than defending shrinking core markets.

items.title_zh: 意法、聯發科齊調漲 IC設計族群受惠
items.title_en: STMicro and MediaTek hike chip prices, lifting downstream IC designers
items.summary_zh: 意法半導體通知客戶，旗下微控制器（MCU）產品將自6月28日起啟動新一輪調漲，盛群、偉詮電、松翰等台廠MCU業者可望受惠，下半年營運增溫。另一方面，聯發科近日罕見以函文方式對客戶重新檢視訂價結構、因應成本上升，市場解讀為IC設計產業漲價風向轉變的訊號，電源管理等IC設計廠不排除跟進。在先進製程與封裝產能緊俏、供應鏈成本墊高下，漲價題材成為IC設計族群股價催化劑。
items.summary_en: STMicroelectronics has notified customers that its microcontroller (MCU) lineup will see a new round of increases starting June 28, a tailwind for Taiwanese MCU makers such as Holtek, Weltrend and Sonix as second-half operations heat up. Separately, MediaTek issued a formal letter to customers re-examining its pricing structure to cope with rising costs—an unusual move that the market reads as a signal that power-management and other IC designers may follow with their own hikes.

items.title_zh: 台積電集團傳再蓋封測廠 進駐中科二林園區 矽品也提第五廠
items.title_en: TSMC group plans another advanced packaging fab at Central Taiwan's Erlin park
items.summary_zh: 繼中科二期啟動1.4奈米先進製程建廠後，供應鏈再傳台積電集團旗下公司將前進中科二林園區投資先進封測新廠，近期將提出投資申請，初估總投資金額上看數百億元；旗下矽品也提出第五廠計畫。此舉凸顯先進封裝產能已成AI時代晶片需求的戰略瓶頸，台積電持續擴大封測布局以滿足CoWoS等先進封裝需求，相關設備、材料與在地供應鏈可望同步受惠。
items.summary_en: Following its 1.4nm advanced-process fab plan at the Central Taiwan Science Park's second phase, TSMC's group is reportedly heading to the Erlin park to invest in a new advanced testing-and-packaging plant, with an application expected soon and total investment estimated in the tens of billions of NT dollars. Affiliate SPIL is also said to be proposing a fifth plant, underscoring how packaging capacity has become the strategic bottleneck for AI-era chip demand.

items.title_zh: DRAM缺貨漲價潮延燒到DDR2 記憶體題材續熱
items.title_en: DRAM shortage and price surge spread to legacy DDR products
items.summary_zh: 記憶體上行循環擴大，DRAM缺貨與漲價潮如今延燒到舊製程的DDR2級產品，顯示供給吃緊已從尖端HBM、DDR5蔓延至全品類記憶體，而非僅集中於高階產品。此趨勢使記憶體持續成為盤面焦點題材，華邦電、南亞科及模組／控制IC廠群聯等台廠可望受惠，法人買盤也明顯集中於記憶體族群，帶動相關個股股價表現，後續仍須觀察報價漲勢與終端需求能否延續。
items.summary_en: The memory upcycle is broadening: persistent DRAM shortages and price increases are now extending even to older DDR2-class products, a sign that tight supply is rippling across the full memory spectrum rather than just leading-edge HBM and DDR5. The trend keeps memory firmly in focus as a market theme, benefiting Taiwanese makers such as Winbond, Nanya Technology and module/controller player Phison as institutional buyers concentrate positions in the segment.

items.title_zh: 玻纖布、銅箔等材料吃緊 PCB進入「圈料時代」
items.title_en: PCB sector enters an "allocation era" as glass fabric and copper foil tighten
items.summary_zh: 玻纖布、銅箔等PCB關鍵材料供應吃緊，迫使印刷電路板產業進入「圈料時代」，供應商改採視料生產、依配額供貨，並緊盯新產能何時開出。此波缺料反映AI需求推升高層數、高規格板需求，速度超過上游材料供給，使整條電子製造供應鏈面臨成本上揚與交期拉長風險。對PCB及其上游材料廠而言，供需失衡同時帶來漲價契機與產能調度壓力，後市須觀察擴產進度。
items.summary_en: Shortages in key PCB materials such as glass-fiber cloth and copper foil are forcing the printed-circuit-board industry into an "allocation era," where suppliers ration output and deliver against quotas while watching nervously for new capacity to come online. The squeeze reflects AI-driven demand for high-layer-count, high-spec boards outrunning upstream material supply, raising costs and lead-time risks across the electronics manufacturing chain.

items.title_zh: 橋梁掀改建潮 鋼構廠熱身 明年相關商機估逾300億 中鋼、長榮鋼受惠
items.title_en: Bridge rebuilding boom to lift steel-structure makers, with NT$30bn+ in orders
items.summary_zh: 極端氣候加劇、橋梁老化問題浮現，加上交通基礎建設升級需求擴大，迎來新一波橋梁更新與重建高峰，估計2027年國內橋梁所需鋼結構用量上看24萬公噸，相關商機將超過300億元。鋼構產業鏈中的中鋼、中鋼構、長榮鋼等業者可望受惠，公共工程支出導入結構用鋼需求，為鋼構族群提供中長期成長動能，並有助改善鋼鐵業景氣，後續可觀察標案釋出與接單進度。
items.summary_en: Intensifying extreme weather, ageing bridges and upgrades to transport infrastructure are driving a fresh wave of bridge renewal and reconstruction, with domestic demand for structural steel projected to reach 240,000 tonnes by 2027 and related business topping NT$30 billion. Steel-chain players such as China Steel, China Steel Structure and Evergreen Steel are positioned to benefit as public-works spending channels into structural steel demand.

items.title_zh: 13家銀行捲收佣風暴 掀開銀行圈不能說的祕密
items.title_en: Commission "kickback storm" engulfs 13 banks, exposing a grey area
items.summary_zh: 一場收佣（佣金、收佣）風暴擴大，竟一口氣牽連13家銀行，掀開銀行圈最敏感的灰色地帶——銷售佣金與轉介費用如何處理的潛規則。此事件勢必引來主管機關對銷售通路行為、資訊揭露與獎酬結構的關注，後續恐衝擊各行庫的法令遵循實務，並牽動手續費收入的認列方式。對重視財管與通路收入的銀行而言，如何在業績壓力與合規之間取得平衡，將是重要課題。
items.summary_en: A widening commission/fee scandal has drawn in 13 banks, lifting the lid on one of the banking industry's most sensitive grey zones around how sales commissions and referral fees are handled. The episode is set to draw regulatory scrutiny over conduct, disclosure and incentive structures in bank sales channels, with potential implications for compliance practices and the way fee income is booked across the sector.

items.title_zh: 國銀新南向放款衝新高 前五月達2,511億元
items.title_en: Banks' New Southbound lending races toward a record high
items.summary_zh: 今年才過不到一半，國銀新南向放款已快追平歷史全年紀錄。金管會統計，前五月新增放款衝上2,511億元，距2022年全年高峰2,657億元僅差146億元，若動能延續，6月可望提前改寫歷史新高。此趨勢反映供應鏈移轉與台商在東南亞、南亞布局擴張，帶動企業金融與海外授信需求成長，也使新南向市場成為國銀拓展海外獲利的重點戰場，惟須留意當地信用與匯率風險控管。
items.summary_en: Less than halfway through the year, domestic banks' new lending under the New Southbound Policy has nearly matched its full-year record: FSC data show new loans hit NT$251.1 billion in the first five months, just NT$14.6 billion shy of the 2022 full-year peak of NT$265.7 billion, with June likely to set a fresh all-time high if momentum holds. The surge reflects supply-chain relocation and Taiwanese firms' expanding footprint across Southeast Asia and South Asia.

items.title_zh: 金管會發布「金融業後量子密碼遷移參考指引」 強化量子風險整備
items.title_en: FSC issues post-quantum cryptography migration guidance for financial firms
items.summary_zh: 金管會發布「金融業後量子密碼遷移參考指引」，引導金融機構強化量子風險整備。該指引協助銀行、保險、證券業者盤點現有加密資產，並規劃遷移至抗量子加密機制，以因應未來量子電腦運算能力提升、可能破解既有資安防護的風險。隨著量子技術發展，後量子密碼遷移已成金融業營運韌性與資安的重要課題，業者須提前布局密碼演算法升級與系統改造，避免長期累積的資安債務在量子時代集中爆發。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's Financial Supervisory Commission has released a "Post-Quantum Cryptography Migration Reference Guideline" to steer financial institutions in strengthening their readiness against quantum-computing risks. The guidance aims to help banks, insurers and securities firms inventory cryptographic assets and plan a transition to quantum-resistant encryption before advances in quantum computing threaten existing security mechanisms—an increasingly pressing operational-resilience and cybersecurity priority for the sector.

items.title_zh: 郭明鑑辭任國泰投信董事 國泰金：受影響基金投資人啟動從優補償
items.title_en: Cathay SITE director Kuo Ming-chien resigns; Cathay pledges top-tier investor compensation
items.summary_zh: 國泰金控代子公司國泰投信公告，原董事郭明鑑辭任董事職務。國泰金表示，為維護基金受益人權益，已依最高標準建立公司治理機制，並將對受影響基金投資人啟動從優補償。此舉凸顯資產管理業者在人事異動之際對受託人責任與投資人保護的重視，後續市場關注相關基金的後續管理安排與投資人權益保障措施，是否能穩定受益人信心並維持資產規模。
items.summary_en: Cathay Financial announced on behalf of subsidiary Cathay Securities Investment Trust that director Kuo Ming-chien has resigned his board seat. To protect fund beneficiaries, Cathay said it has established governance mechanisms to the "highest standard" and will launch a preferential compensation program for affected fund investors, signalling an emphasis on fiduciary duty and investor protection amid the leadership change at the asset manager.

items.title_zh: 臺企銀獲准開辦財管2.0 搶攻高資產客戶市場
items.title_en: Taiwan Business Bank wins approval for "Wealth Management 2.0," targeting high-net-worth clients
items.summary_zh: 臺企銀正式進軍高資產客戶市場，獲主管機關核准辦理高資產客戶適用之金融商品及服務，即財管2.0業務。臺企銀近年持續深化財富管理布局，業務已連續三年維持雙位數成長，展現強勁動能；未來將結合多元商品與專業顧問資源，搶攻高資產客群。此為國內銀行強化私人銀行式服務、爭奪富裕客戶的最新一步，後續可觀察其商品結構、AUM成長與財管手續費收入貢獻，以及與既有財管2.0同業的競爭態勢。
items.summary_en: Taiwan Business Bank has formally entered the high-net-worth client market after regulators approved it to offer the financial products and services known as "Wealth Management 2.0." The bank, whose wealth-management business has grown at double-digit rates for three straight years, plans to combine a broader product shelf with professional advisory resources to capture affluent clients—part of a wider industry push to build out private-banking-style offerings in Taiwan.

items.title_zh: 金管會同意臺銀、臺企銀、遠銀辦理高資產客戶業務
items.title_en: FSC approves three banks to run high-net-worth client business
items.summary_zh: 金管會同意臺灣銀行、臺灣中小企業銀行及遠東國際商業銀行辦理高資產客戶適用之金融商品及服務（財管2.0）。此舉擴大爭奪富裕客群的銀行陣容，業者可提供更多元、進階的商品菜單，包括結構型商品與境外金融工具，深化台灣發展高端財富管理與資產管理市場的政策方向。對高資產客戶而言，可選擇的商品與顧問服務更趨豐富，銀行端則須強化商品適合度、風險揭露與KYC流程，在搶占AUM與手續費收入的同時兼顧合規與客戶保護。
items.summary_en: The FSC has given the green light to Bank of Taiwan, Taiwan Business Bank and Far Eastern International Bank to offer financial products and services for high-net-worth clients under the Wealth Management 2.0 framework. The approvals widen the roster of banks competing for affluent customers with more sophisticated product menus—including structured products and offshore instruments—deepening Taiwan's effort to develop its high-end wealth-management and asset-management market.

items.title_zh: 「非完全退休」時代來了 台人延退意願最高 只存現金實質回報恐趨零
items.title_en: The "non-full retirement" era arrives, with Taiwanese most willing to delay retirement
items.summary_zh: 亞洲正進入「非完全退休」時代，退休觀念從「停止工作」轉變為人生階段的轉型。富達國際指出，最新調查顯示兩岸三地民眾不再將退休視為終點，而視為持續貢獻社會、延續人生的階段，其中台灣人延後退休的意願最高。報告同時警告，若退休理財只知存現金，在通膨侵蝕下實質回報率恐趨近於零。此對財富管理與退休規劃具重要啟示：客戶需要更積極的資產配置與長期投資組合，以對抗長壽風險與購買力流失，財管業者亦可藉此深化退休理財顧問服務。
items.summary_en: Asia is entering an era of "non-full retirement," where retirement is reframed from "stopping work" to a life-stage transition, according to Fidelity International. A survey found people across Greater China no longer see retirement as an endpoint but as continued social contribution, with Taiwanese showing the highest willingness to delay retirement. The report warns that relying solely on cash savings risks real returns trending toward zero—underscoring the need for proper retirement-asset allocation.

items.title_zh: 元大壽美元利變險 助攻創業
items.title_en: Yuanta Life's USD interest-sensitive policy pitched as an entrepreneurship tool
items.summary_zh: 元大人壽主打一款美元利率變動型（利變）壽險商品，定位為協助客戶創業與財富規劃的工具，搶攻在美元走強、美元利率仍處相對高位下的外幣儲蓄與保障需求。美元利變保單是財富管理常見的工具之一，可協助客戶分散幣別配置並鎖定較高利率，惟投保人須衡量匯率波動風險與保單相關成本。對財管與保險通路而言，外幣保單仍是高資產與一般客群兼具的重要商品線，須留意適合度與外匯風險的充分揭露。
items.summary_en: Yuanta Life is promoting a U.S. dollar interest-sensitive (variable) life insurance product positioned to support clients' entrepreneurship and wealth-planning needs, tapping demand for foreign-currency-denominated savings and protection amid a strong dollar and elevated USD rates. Such interest-sensitive FX policies remain a popular wealth-management tool for diversifying currency exposure and locking in higher yields, though buyers must weigh exchange-rate risk and policy costs.

items.title_zh: 很多人不知道！子女滿18歲後 房屋稅藏省稅空間
items.title_en: Little-known tax break: a child turning 18 can unlock house-tax savings
items.summary_zh: 民眾申請房屋稅自住優惠稅率時，須留意成年子女名下房屋的計算方式。雲林縣稅務局表示，自民法將成年年齡下修至18歲後，子女只要年滿18歲，其名下房屋即可獨立計算自住房屋戶數，不再併入父母及未成年子女全國三戶的計算。換言之，善用成年子女的獨立戶數認定，有機會讓全家維持自住優惠稅率，創造合法的房屋稅節稅空間。此提醒對持有多戶不動產的家庭具實務價值，建議在申報自住優惠前，先盤點家庭成員的年齡與持有狀況，避免因戶數計算錯誤而喪失優惠或補稅。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's Yunlin County Revenue Service reminds homeowners to mind how adult children's properties are counted when applying for the owner-occupied preferential house-tax rate. Since the Civil Code lowered the age of majority to 18, a child who reaches 18 can have their property counted as an independent owner-occupied unit, no longer folded into the parents' and minor children's nationwide tally of three—potentially preserving the preferential rate for the whole household and creating room for legitimate house-tax savings.

items.title_zh: 鋼鐵春燕飛了？日本指我國鋼材將課反傾銷稅 經濟部：衝擊有限
items.title_en: Japan moves toward anti-dumping duties on Taiwanese steel; impact seen limited
items.summary_zh: 日本政府指我國鋼材涉及傾銷，燁聯（9957）及華新麗華（1605）兩家業者受影響，市場擔心鋼鐵業景氣才剛轉好，馬上遭逢日本課反傾銷稅，形容「春燕又飛了」。經濟部22日表示，該案對我國業者輸日整體表現影響有限，試圖安撫市場對此貿易救濟措施的疑慮。反傾銷稅屬國際貿易法規與關稅議題，後續須觀察日方調查與課稅範圍、稅率，以及對相關鋼廠輸日訂單與毛利的實質衝擊，業者亦可評估透過調整出口市場或產品組合因應。
items.summary_en: The Japanese government has indicated that Taiwanese steel products are suspected of dumping, with Yieh Phui (9957) and Walsin Lihwa (1605) named as affected producers—prompting market worries that "the swallows of spring have flown away" just as the steel cycle was turning up. Taiwan's Ministry of Economic Affairs said on June 22 that the case's impact on overall steel exports to Japan would be limited, seeking to calm concerns over the trade-remedy action.

items.title_zh: 瑞銀上修台灣2026 GDP至9.9% IMD競爭力躍居全球第4
items.title_en: UBS lifts Taiwan's 2026 GDP forecast to 9.9%; IMD ranks Taiwan 4th
items.summary_zh: 台灣景氣展望明顯轉強，瑞銀（UBS）將台灣2026年GDP成長預測由8%上修至9.9%，滙豐則看好出口帶動經濟成長。樂觀預期與台灣在洛桑管理學院（IMD）世界競爭力評比躍居全球第4、寫下歷年最佳紀錄相呼應。上修主因AI與半導體帶動的出口動能強韌，惟如此高的成長預估也墊高後續實際數據與政策執行的標準，須留意全球景氣、地緣政治與匯率變數是否影響出口續航力。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's growth outlook brightened markedly: UBS raised its 2026 GDP growth forecast for Taiwan from 8% to 9.9%, and HSBC pointed to exports driving expansion. The optimism dovetails with Taiwan climbing to 4th in IMD's World Competitiveness Ranking—its best result on record. The upgrades reflect resilient export momentum led by AI and semiconductors, though such elevated growth estimates also raise the bar for actual data and policy execution in coming quarters.

items.title_zh: 碳費入帳七成補助企業 約29億用於利息補貼、淨零貸款
items.title_en: First carbon-fee revenue: 70% to subsidize firms, about NT$2.9bn for green loans and rate subsidies
items.summary_zh: 首筆碳費入帳，撥入溫管基金可支用部分將有七成、約29億元用於補助企業，包含利息補貼、獎勵減碳技術投資、淨零貸款等。其中企業綠色貸款的利息補貼，限制用於購買五類減碳機器或設備，每家利息補貼貸款額度設有上限。此舉將碳定價收入回流產業減碳，協助企業降低低碳轉型的資金成本。對製造業與金融業而言，淨零貸款與利息補貼可望帶動綠色融資需求，後續須觀察補助申請門檻、撥款效率與實際減碳成效。
items.summary_en: The first carbon-fee receipts have flowed into the GHG management fund, with the usable portion allocated 70%—roughly NT$2.9 billion—to subsidize enterprises, including interest subsidies, rewards for emissions-reduction technology investment and net-zero loans. Corporate green-loan interest subsidies are restricted to purchases of five categories of decarbonization machinery or equipment, with a per-company subsidized-loan cap, channeling carbon-pricing proceeds back into industrial decarbonization.

items.title_zh: 2,100億無人機採購 朝野攻防 綠藍白各有盤算
items.title_en: NT$210bn drone procurement special act sparks cross-party wrangling
items.summary_zh: 行政院提出規模2,100億元的無人機特別條例，朝野攻防已開打，民進黨、國民黨、民眾黨三黨各有盤算。民進黨團喊話立法院長韓國瑜加速審查草案；在野則持續整合意見，部分主張自提專法版本或修法，部分則認為不需立特別條例。此案牽動國防自主與無人機產業鏈的龐大商機與預算分配，後續立法進度與條例範圍將影響相關供應鏈投資與政府支出節奏，值得持續關注朝野協商結果。
items.summary_en: The Executive Yuan's proposed special act for a NT$210 billion drone procurement program has ignited partisan maneuvering, with the DPP, KMT and TPP each pursuing their own calculations. The DPP caucus urged Legislative Speaker Han Kuo-yu to speed up review, while opposition parties continue to coordinate positions—some favoring their own draft legislation or amendments, others arguing a special act is unnecessary—setting up a legislative tug-of-war over defense-industry spending.

items.title_zh: 中國又對美稀土出手！MP Materials、USA Rare Earth遭列出口管制
items.title_en: China hits back on rare earths, blacklisting two U.S. producers
items.summary_zh: 中國宣布將MP Materials與USA Rare Earth列入出口管制清單，禁止其取得中國原產軍民兩用物項。此舉被視為回應美國制裁中國企業，也凸顯全球稀土供應鏈與G7「去中國化」關鍵礦產戰略競爭持續升溫。對仰賴稀土的國防、電動車與高科技製造業者而言，供應安全疑慮再起，恐推升相關原料成本並加速供應鏈分散布局。中美在關鍵礦產的反制循環，料將持續成為地緣政治與產業政策的重要變數。
items.summary_en: China announced it will place MP Materials and USA Rare Earth on its export-control list, barring them from obtaining China-origin dual-use items. The move is seen as retaliation against U.S. sanctions on Chinese firms and highlights escalating strategic competition over the global rare-earth supply chain and G7 efforts to "de-China" critical-minerals sourcing—raising fresh supply-security concerns for defense, EV and high-tech manufacturers reliant on rare earths.

items.title_zh: 美伊和談露曙光、美放寬伊朗石油限制 國際油價走低
items.title_en: Oil slips as U.S.–Iran talks progress and Washington grants export waivers
items.summary_zh: 國際油價周一走低，主因美伊和談傳出進展，加上華府宣布對部分伊朗石油出口提供60天豁免授權，市場預期波斯灣原油供應將逐步恢復，緩解先前因中東戰事引發的供應疑慮。和緩情勢降低了原本支撐油價的地緣政治風險溢價，惟後續和解能否持續仍是能源市場最大變數。對台灣等高度依賴進口能源的經濟體而言，油價回落有助降低輸入性通膨壓力，但中東情勢反覆仍可能再度推升避險需求與運費風險。
items.summary_en: International oil prices fell on Monday as U.S.–Iran negotiations showed signs of progress and Washington granted a 60-day waiver authorizing some Iranian oil exports, leaving markets to expect a gradual recovery of Persian Gulf crude supply and easing fears stoked by the earlier Middle East conflict. The thaw reduces the geopolitical risk premium that had supported prices, though the durability of any de-escalation remains the key swing factor for energy markets.

items.title_zh: 不只做晶片！輝達瞄準人形機器人2000億美元商機
items.title_en: Nvidia eyes a US$200 billion humanoid-robot opportunity
items.summary_zh: AI晶片龍頭輝達正積極推動人形機器人發展，推出一套專為人形機器人設計的軟硬體方案，並將「安全性」視為產業邁向大規模商用的關鍵門檻。此舉顯示輝達企圖跨出晶片、進軍完整機器人平台，將人形機器人視為估值上看數千億美元的龐大新市場，並可能成為整體AI硬體生態系的下一個成長引擎。對台廠而言，輝達的機器人布局有望帶動機構件、感測、控制與代工供應鏈新商機，惟商業化時程與安全規範仍需時間驗證。
items.summary_en: AI-chip leader Nvidia is pushing aggressively into humanoid robots, unveiling a dedicated hardware-and-software stack and flagging "safety" as the key threshold for the industry to reach large-scale commercialization. The move signals Nvidia's ambition to extend beyond chips into the full robotics platform, positioning humanoid robots as a major new addressable market estimated at hundreds of billions of dollars and a potential next growth engine for the broader AI hardware ecosystem.

items.title_zh: SK海力士超車三星 AI時代改寫南韓科技霸權
items.title_en: SK Hynix overtakes Samsung, rewriting South Korea's tech hierarchy in the AI era
items.summary_zh: SK海力士在AI浪潮帶動下超車三星，象徵性地改寫南韓科技權力結構，關鍵在於高頻寬記憶體（HBM）的領先地位。此一翻轉凸顯AI驅動的先進記憶體需求，已成為全球晶片大廠決勝的戰場，HBM布局如今是競爭地位的關鍵決定因素。南韓6月前20日半導體出口更激增近190%，顯示記憶體景氣強勁。此趨勢同樣牽動台灣記憶體與封裝供應鏈，相關台廠可望受惠於整體記憶體上行循環與AI需求外溢。
items.summary_en: SK Hynix has surpassed Samsung in a symbolic shift driven by the AI boom, as leadership in high-bandwidth memory (HBM) reshapes South Korea's tech power structure. The reversal underscores how AI-driven demand for advanced memory has become the decisive battleground among global chipmakers, with HBM positioning now a key determinant of competitive standing—an dynamic that also reverberates through Taiwan's memory and packaging supply chains.

items.title_zh: Alphabet因AI人才出走疑慮 創逾一年最大單日跌幅
items.title_en: Alphabet has its worst day in over a year on AI talent-exit fears
items.summary_zh: Google母公司Alphabet在多位重量級AI研究人員（包含一位諾貝爾獎得主）傳出將轉投競爭對手實驗室後，股價創逾一年來最大單日跌幅。投資人擔心Alphabet在AI人才爭奪戰中落於下風，市場將人才出走解讀為其AI發展藍圖與競爭地位承壓的訊號，使股價明顯回落。(2026-06-23)
items.summary_en: Google parent Alphabet suffered its steepest single-day drop in more than a year after a series of high-profile artificial-intelligence researchers, including a Nobel laureate, signaled they would leave for rival labs. Investors fear Alphabet is losing the war for AI talent just as competition intensifies, with the market reading the departures as a sign of mounting pressure on its AI roadmap and competitive positioning. (2026-06-23)

items.title_zh: Alphabet市值蒸發約2,250億美元
items.title_en: Alphabet sees about US$225 billion market-cap wipeout
items.summary_zh: Alphabet股價下跌使市值蒸發約2,250億美元，投資人憂心其在AI人才戰中落敗，因近期有兩位AI領袖（含一位諾貝爾獎得主）表示將離開Google、轉投競爭對手實驗室。如此龐大的市值縮水凸顯大型科技股估值對「AI領導地位」與留住頂尖研究人才能力的觀感極為敏感。(2026-06-23)
items.summary_en: Alphabet's slide erased roughly US$225 billion in market value as investors worried it is losing the war for AI talent, after two AI leaders—including a Nobel laureate—recently said they would leave Google for rival labs. The scale of the wipeout underscores how sensitive mega-cap tech valuations have become to perceptions of AI leadership and the ability to retain top research talent. (2026-06-23)

items.title_zh: SpaceX與AI新創Reflection簽運算合約 上看63億美元
items.title_en: SpaceX signs computing-power deal with AI startup Reflection worth up to US$6.3bn
items.summary_zh: SpaceX將旗下Colossus資料中心轉為商業運算平台，與開源AI新創Reflection簽下上看63億美元的合約。此合約延續其先前與Anthropic、Google及Cursor的合作，標誌SpaceX積極將資料中心產能變現、向AI開發者出售運算資源，並跨出火箭發射與衛星核心本業、拓展多元營收。(2026-06-22)
items.summary_en: SpaceX has turned its Colossus data center into a commercial computing-power platform, signing a deal worth up to US$6.3 billion with open-source AI startup Reflection. The agreement follows recent deals with Anthropic, Google and Cursor, marking SpaceX's push to monetize its data-center capacity by selling compute to AI developers and diversifying beyond its core launch and satellite businesses. (2026-06-22)

items.title_zh: SpaceX市值蒸發4,000億美元 跌破上市首日收盤價
items.title_en: SpaceX sheds US$400 billion in value, slipping below its IPO-day close
items.summary_zh: SpaceX市值蒸發約4,000億美元，股價跌破上市首日收盤價，意味在首個交易日之後買進者帳面上已套牢。此波重挫顯示這檔歷史性IPO的掛牌「蜜月行情」降溫，投資人開始重新評估其高估值與獲利前景是否相稱，上市熱潮明顯退燒。(2026-06-23)
items.summary_en: SpaceX shed about US$400 billion in market value as its stock slid below its IPO-day closing price, meaning anyone who bought after the first trading day is now underwater—at least on paper. The sharp pullback signals cooling enthusiasm after the historic IPO's debut "honeymoon," as investors reassess the lofty valuation against the company's earnings path. (2026-06-23)

items.title_zh: 美國允許伊朗以美元售油 數十年來首見
items.title_en: U.S. allows Iran to sell oil in dollars for the first time in decades
items.summary_zh: 美國暫時拆除對伊朗石油產業的制裁，允許德黑蘭數十年來首度以美元銷售原油，使該政權更容易匯回原油出口利潤。此決定是重大的地緣政治轉折，緩解油市供應疑慮，但也引發外界對此安排能否持久及其對全球能源流向影響的疑問。(2026-06-23)
items.summary_en: The U.S. temporarily dismantled sanctions on Iran's oil industry, allowing Tehran to sell crude in dollars for the first time in decades and making it easier for the regime to repatriate profits from its exports. The decision marks a significant geopolitical shift, easing supply concerns in oil markets while raising questions about the durability of the arrangement and its impact on global energy flows. (2026-06-23)

items.title_zh: 前Fed主席葛林斯潘辭世 享嵩壽100歲
items.title_en: Alan Greenspan, former Fed chairman, dies at 100
items.summary_zh: 曾在四位總統任內執掌聯準會（Fed）長達19年、並精通被稱為「Fedspeak」模糊溝通藝術的葛林斯潘（Alan Greenspan）辭世，享嵩壽100歲。葛林斯潘是現代史上最具影響力的央行總裁之一，任期橫跨多起重大市場事件，深刻形塑數十年來美國貨幣政策的辯論方向。(2026-06-22)
items.summary_en: Alan Greenspan, who presided over the Federal Reserve for 19 years under four presidents and mastered the obfuscating communication style known as "Fedspeak," has died at age 100. Greenspan was one of the most influential central bankers in modern history, his tenure spanning major market events and shaping decades of U.S. monetary policy debate. (2026-06-22)

items.title_zh: 英相施凱爾辭職 英國10年來迎第七位領導人
items.title_en: UK PM Starmer resigns, as Britain faces its seventh leader in 10 years
items.summary_zh: 英國首相施凱爾（Keir Starmer）宣布將辭去首相與工黨黨魁職務，觸發繼任者爭奪戰，使英國10年來將迎來第七位領導人。此次辭職為英國注入新的政治不確定性，工黨忙於推選新黨魁之際，投資人正評估其對財政政策、市場與英鎊的影響。(2026-06-22)
items.summary_en: Keir Starmer said he will resign as U.K. prime minister and Labour leader, triggering a contest to choose his successor and leaving Britain on course for its seventh leader in a decade. The resignation injects fresh political uncertainty into the UK, with investors weighing the implications for fiscal policy, markets and sterling as the Labour Party scrambles to pick a new leader. (2026-06-22)

items.title_zh: 美光與Anthropic達成新合作 股價動能增強
items.title_en: Micron's stock momentum builds on a new Anthropic partnership
items.summary_zh: 美光（Micron）宣布與AI公司Anthropic達成新合作、簽署記憶體與儲存供應協議後，股價動能增強。此合作再次顯示AI需求飆升正促使記憶體廠取得長期供應承諾，使美光可望受惠於資料中心擴建，因AI開發者鎖定所需的高頻寬記憶體與儲存產能。此趨勢對台灣記憶體供應鏈亦具正面外溢效果。(2026-06-23)
items.summary_en: Micron's shares gained fresh momentum after the company announced a new partnership with AI firm Anthropic, signing a supply agreement for memory and storage. The deal reinforces how surging AI demand is driving long-term supply commitments for memory makers, positioning Micron to benefit from data-center buildouts as AI developers lock in the high-bandwidth memory and storage capacity they need. (2026-06-23)

items.title_zh: 艾伯維將以109億美元收購免疫藥廠Apogee
items.title_en: AbbVie to buy immunology drugmaker Apogee for US$10.9 billion
items.summary_zh: 艾伯維（AbbVie）同意以109億美元現金收購Apogee Therapeutics，將新增一款治療中重度異位性皮膚炎的實驗性藥物，強化其核心免疫學業務。此交易凸顯大型藥廠持續透過併購補充產品線、在專利懸崖前捍衛主力產品的策略，而免疫學領域仍是競爭激烈的重點治療領域。(2026-06-22)
items.summary_en: AbbVie agreed to acquire Apogee Therapeutics for US$10.9 billion in cash, adding an experimental drug for moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis and building up its core immunology business. The deal underscores big pharma's continued appetite for bolt-on acquisitions to refill pipelines and defend franchises against patent cliffs, with immunology remaining a fiercely contested therapeutic area. (2026-06-22)

items.title_zh: 卡達天然氣廠爆炸 釀13死、數十人受傷
items.title_en: Explosion at Qatar natural-gas plant leaves 13 dead, dozens injured
items.summary_zh: 卡達拉斯拉凡（Ras Laffan）工業園區在啟動營運過程中發生爆炸，造成13人死亡、數十人受傷，事故發生之際卡達正努力恢復因中東衝突中斷數月的液化天然氣（LNG）出口。此事件在能源市場敏感時刻，再度引發外界對能源基礎設施安全與全球LNG供應恢復速度的疑慮。(2026-06-22)
items.summary_en: A blast struck during the startup of operations at Qatar's Ras Laffan industrial complex, leaving 13 people dead and dozens injured, as Qatar works to restore LNG exports disrupted by months of Middle East conflict. The incident raises fresh concerns about energy infrastructure safety and the pace of recovery for global liquefied-natural-gas supply at a sensitive time for energy markets. (2026-06-22)
